title: 第7章 猜透第8章 前朝皇族
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: “赵岚，如果你现在认罪，或许我还可以为你适当减罪量刑。”
裴苏道。
“你在说什么！你到底在说什么！”
赵岚声音狂躁，然后直直盯着柳芷。
“小姐！你怎么能跟他一起，一起设计算计我！”
“哼！对付你这样的贼人，用多卑劣的手段都不为过！”
有裴苏在旁，柳芷丝毫不惧，厉声叫嚣。
“我对你一片真心，我对······”
“够了，你刚知道殿下抵达州府，就急忙忙地跑去给你的萧伯告密！别以为我不知道！”
赵岚一时凝噎，然后望着裴苏。
“我萧伯怎么了？”
裴苏依旧含笑，微微挑眉。
“你跟着他习了这么多年武功刀法，难道真不知道他的底细吗？”
赵岚忽然一愣。
萧伯的底细？
萧伯究竟是什么来头，居然能引起，引起北侯世子这样人物的注意！
“那我告诉你吧，那位教了你二十年刀法的老铁匠，实则是前皇宫禁军人士，左羽林卫副统领，天子授职的亲军校尉。”
赵岚腿脚一软，脑瓜子嗡嗡。
他虽然猜测萧伯来历非凡，但也绝想不到，居然有这么大的来头！
皇宫禁军羽林卫！
那可是待在圣上身边的人物，天底下最精锐最非凡的一支队伍，而萧伯，二十年前居然是其副统领？！
天子近臣，就是一州州牧柳公允也得以礼相待，怪不得萧伯曾对来自帝京的监察使不屑一顾。
“还有更惊讶的呢，他还是二十年前夺刀龙雀潜逃的叛臣，你说你这养父，胆子大不大。”
赵岚刚刚恢复一丝清醒的脑子又翁的一声炸开。
他听到了什么？
神刀龙雀！
二十年前那场神兵失窃案不仅仅震惊朝野，而是天下七十二州俱震动不已。
那可是朝廷至宝，神刀龙雀！
在入北的过程中遭人盗窃，天下侠义之士无不震怒，誓要手刃贼子。
他跟萧伯俱练刀，甚至他还不止一次在萧伯面前提及此事，面露愠色。
怎么可能？
萧伯怎么可能会是盗取龙雀的贼子。
“不可能！我不相信！”
赵岚大叫起来。
虽然萧伯平日对他严厉，说话也冷酷，但他能够看出萧伯绝非贼人，也是拥有一腔报效家国的侠肝义胆！
“知人知面不知心，你不必为他开脱。”
“萧伯！萧伯！你千万不要出来。”
赵岚大叫，神情激动。
见状，裴苏摇了摇头。
这赵岚的心智，比他养父简直差了不知多少。
也是，毕竟一个是禁军统领，年愈七十，一个是贫民小子，不过半甲。
“你不用喊了，你那养父又不在此处，怎会有应答。”
赵岚声音哑住，转过身，瞪大眼睛望着裴苏。

"Zhao Lan, if you plead guilty now, maybe I can reduce your crime and sentence appropriately."
Pei Su said.
"What are you talking about! What on earth are you talking about!"
Zhao Lan's voice was manic, and then she stared straight at Liu Zhi.
"Miss! How can you work with him to plot against me!"
"Hmph! No amount of despicable means can be used to deal with a thief like you!"
With Pei Su by her side, Liu Zhi was not afraid at all and shouted loudly.
"I am sincere to you, I am..."
"That's enough. As soon as you knew His Highness arrived at the state capital, you hurriedly ran to inform your Uncle Xiao! Don't think I don't know!"
"I..."
Zhao Lan choked for a moment, then looked at Pei Su.
"What happened to me, Uncle Xiao?"
Pei Su still smiled and raised his eyebrows slightly.
"You have practiced martial arts and sword skills with him for so many years, do you really not know his background?"
Zhao Lan was suddenly stunned.
Uncle Xiao’s background?
What is Uncle Xiao's background that can actually attract the attention of someone like the Prince of Beihou!
"Then let me tell you, the old blacksmith who has taught you swordsmanship for twenty years is actually a former member of the Royal Palace Guards, the deputy commander of Zuoyu Linwei, and a pro-military captain appointed by the emperor."
Zhao Lan's legs and feet went weak, and her head was buzzing.
Although he guessed that Uncle Xiao had an extraordinary background, he never imagined that he had such a big background!
Imperial Palace Imperial Guards, Habayashi Guards!
Those were the people who stayed with the Holy Master, the most elite and extraordinary team in the world, and Uncle Xiao was actually its deputy commander twenty years ago? !
The emperor's close ministers, even the governor Liu Gongyun of Yizhou, were treated with courtesy. No wonder Uncle Xiao once dismissed the supervisors from the imperial capital.
"What's even more surprising is that he is the traitor who took the sword and escaped twenty years ago. Do you think your adoptive father is very courageous?"
Zhao Lan's brain, which had just regained some clarity, exploded again.
What did he hear?
Divine Sword Dragon Bird!
The theft of the magic weapon twenty years ago not only shocked the government and the opposition, but also shocked all seventy-two states in the world.
That is the most precious treasure of the imperial court, the divine sword Dragon Bird!
When he was robbed on his way to the north, all the chivalrous people in the world were furious and vowed to kill the thief.
He practiced swordsmanship with Uncle Xiao, and he even mentioned this matter to Uncle Xiao more than once, with a look of embarrassment on his face.
How is it possible?
How could Uncle Xiao be the thief who stole the dragon bird?
"No way! I don't believe it!"
Zhao Lan shouted.
Although Uncle Xiao was usually strict with him and spoke coldly, he could see that Uncle Xiao was definitely not a thief, and he also had the courage and courage to serve his family and country!
"You don't have to excuse him if he knows his face but not his heart."
"Uncle Xiao! Uncle Xiao! Don't come out."
Zhao Lan shouted, looking excited.
Seeing this, Pei Su shook his head.
Zhao Lan's mind is much worse than his adoptive father's.
Yes, after all, one is the commander of the Forbidden Army, over seventy years old, and the other is a poor boy, only half armor.
"You don't have to shout. Your adoptive father is not here, so how can you get a response?"
Zhao Lan lost her voice, turned around, and looked at Pei Su with wide eyes.
